# Earth 3D Map

> > A comprehensive 3D globe explorer providing real-time geospatial data including weather, earthquakes, and radiation monitoring with interactive satellite imagery.

Earth 3D Map offers an immersive 3D globe interface for exploring Earth's geography, weather patterns, seismic activity, and environmental data. The platform integrates real-time feeds from authoritative sources like USGS, NWS, and EURDEP, with regional maps of major cities and landmarks accessible via web and Chrome extension.

## Key Topics

- 3D interactive globe
- Real-time earthquake monitoring
- Satellite imagery
- Live weather maps
- USGS data
- Seismic activity
- Geographic reference
- World geography
- Radiation monitoring
- Weather forecasting
- Regional maps
- Travel reference
- Chrome extension
- Aerial views
- Global locations

## Core Features

- [Earth 3D Map - Travel around the world](https://earth3dmap.com): Homepage: 3D globe explorer with geographic data navigation
- [3D Interactive Globe](https://earth3dmap.com/3d-globe): 3D interactive globe with high-resolution satellite imagery
- [Live Weather Map - Satellite and Radar](https://earth3dmap.com/weather-map): Real-time weather with geostationary satellite imagery and radar
- [Earthquake Live Map](https://earth3dmap.com/earthquake-live-map): Real-time earthquake monitoring with USGS data, magnitude and location

## Real-Time Environmental Monitoring

- [Snow and Ice Weather Forecast US Map](https://earth3dmap.com/snowfall-us-weather): 72-hour US snowfall and ice forecast with NWS data
- [Radiological Maps - Radiation and Radioactivity Monitoring](https://earth3dmap.com/radiological-maps): Real-time European radiation monitoring with EURDEP data
- [Earthquake in Turkey Live Map](https://earth3dmap.com/earthquake-turkey): Real-time earthquake monitoring for Turkey with USGS data

## Regional Maps & Geographic Exploration

- [Middle East Map](https://earth3dmap.com/middle-east-map): Interactive 3D map of Middle East countries and regions
- [Spain: Map of Spain, Europe - Earth 3D Map](https://earth3dmap.com/spain): Interactive 3D map of Spain with cities and landmarks
- [New York 3D Map](https://earth3dmap.com/new-york-3d-map): Interactive 3D map of New York City and Manhattan
- [Mount Everest 3D Maps](https://earth3dmap.com/mount-everest-3d-maps): Interactive 3D map of Mount Everest and Himalayas
- [Aerial View of Apple Park in Cupertino, California, United States](https://earth3dmap.com/aerial-view-apple-park): Aerial 3D satellite view of Apple Park headquarters

## Browser Extension & Tools

- [Earth 3D Map - Chrome Extension](https://earth3dmap.com/chrome-extension): Chrome extension for bird's-eye 3D map exploration

## Optional

- [Earth 3D Map - Travel around the world](https://earth3dmap.com/page/2): Country directory and geography reference page 2
- [Fix the Google Maps problem "For development purposes only"](https://earth3dmap.com/for-development-purposes-only): Guide to fixing Google Maps API billing and watermark issues
